slots.title: What's on this week
slots.caption:
Big bank holiday weekend ☀️

🍹 Friday - The Friday Social with Jonna & Yumna Black. Laid-back after-work vibes, plus our £15 burger and drink offer until 7pm.

🎧 Saturday - DJ Benzo. A journey through the decades, music you'll know and music you'll sing.

🎪 Bank holiday Sunday - Carnival in the Courtyard. An explosion of colour, immersive carnival decor and the biggest 90s vs 00s singalong anthems. 2pm til midnight.

Tables are available via www.merchantsyardleicester.co.uk

See you in the yard.
